LanguageData.TSOA_MessageAnimaBranchDrop: Branches have fallen from a nearby anima tree. Deconstruct them to yield valuable resources.
LanguageData.TSOA_NotLinked: Not linked to an anima tree
LanguageData.TSOA_SetTapRangeDescription: Set the range that the tap will be active in. Will allow essence to build up until it hits the upper bound, then drain until it hits the lower bound.
LanguageData.TSOA_SapHarvestToggleDesc: Toggle whether this basin will harvest a portion of psychic energy being channeled into the tree from meditation or other sources.
LanguageData.TSOA_SapToggleEmptyingDescription: When active, colonists will automatically empty anima sap from the basin when it is more than half full.
LanguageData.TSOA_SapEmptyNowDescription: When active, colonists will priorize emptying the sap regardless of fullness.
LanguageData.TSOA_BillPsylinkTooLow: Worker's psylink level was lower than recipe requirement of {0}.
LanguageData.TSOA_FacilityMustBeLinked: Must be placed with a valid link.
LanguageData.TSOA_AnimaFontExpiredDescription: the anima leylines have shifted, and the font of anima has expired
LanguageData.TSOA_AnimaFontArriveDesc: {0} has arrived at a font of anima: the stump of an ancient anima tree located at the intersection of powerful leylines of psychic energy.
LanguageData.TSOA_FontLoadSapDesc: Give the order to begin loading anima sap into the font
LanguageData.TSOA_FontBeginDesc: Connect to the anima leylines and begin the crystallization process
LanguageData.TSOA_FontUnloadAmberDesc: Give the order to begin extract crystallized anima amber from the font
LanguageData.TSOA_AskForFontDesc: Ask this faction for the location of an active Font of Anima. Requires {0} goodwill, and costs {1} silver which your caravan must be carrying.
LanguageData.TSOA_AskForFontAlreadySpawned: You already know the location of an active Font of Anima.
LanguageData.TSOA_CrystallizationStartedMessage: The process of crystallizing anima sap into amber has begun. Prepare for danger.
LanguageData.TSOA_CrystallizationFinishedMessage: The Font of Anima has crystallized all the sap it can, and is returning to an inert state. You should collect the amber and leave.
LanguageData.TSOA_FontDestroyedMessage: The Font of Anima has been destroyed. A portion of the amber it held was saved, but most of it was destroyed along with the Font.
LanguageData.TSOA_ConfirmExtractAmber: Are you sure you want to extract the amber early?
LanguageData.TSOA_ConfirmExtractAmber2: Once the amber is extracted, the Font will become inert, and you will have to find a new one.
